voice_choice_rule: User chooses voices only for major characters (series.json → major_characters). Claude chooses minor characters' voices.
engine_rule: ALL character voices are ElevenLabs (user rule, Nov 2026). make_reel.py check fails on any other engine; posted reels keep the audio they were posted with.
